limitations: Owned local process acceptance; no installed supervisor or production traffic switch.
Complete backup/restore, source accounts, real worker deployment and sustained mixed load remain separate gates.
corrected_during_acceptance: Reservation refusal now explicitly aborts its metadata transaction before end; conflict remains HTTP 409 rather than an overwritten 400.
